issues.reason: The reviewer's own q2 records that "such was the case" is a propositional anaphor with no licensed carrier and no in-item antecedent, so this is a coverage gap, not a defect — omitting unencodable content is correct where the alternative would be an invented head, and nothing false was emitted in its place.

"when the Cleveland Cavaliers won ..." is a temporal relative clause on the time NP "Thursday night", so the winning is in fact located at that time and (Time sk_win_1 (Weekday thursday)) / (Time sk_win_1 night) are true of the sentence's content; the only loss is the unencodable matrix clause's own time anchor.

The instruction set defines no identity or alias relation (the reviewer's own gap), and in that gap territory (Member lebron_james_lottery nba_draft_lottery) is true and well-typed on the recurring-event-kind reading — an individual in the individual slot, a kind in the class slot — so it is graceful improvisation, not a falsehood or a class/individual discipline breach.

The objection is to an omission, not to any emitted atom, and the instruction set's own multi-word-name treatment absorbs capitalized elements into one opaque symbol without a separate Name for each part (halvard_of_sunne emits no (Name sunne "Sunne")); with no licensed way to relate the naming organization to the lottery, fusing NBA into the kind symbol emits nothing false.

gaps_confirmed: "Such was the case" — an inverted anaphoric copular clause whose predicate points at a proposition in prior text; event anaphora by pronoun is covered, a propositional anaphor with no in-item antecedent is not
"otherwise known as" / alias apposition — two names for one referent, with exactly one Name fact allowed per proper noun and no identity or alias relation defined
a proper noun as a modifier inside a common-noun compound ("NBA draft lottery") where the referent is not the named entity
new_gaps: the two rules collide in that construction: Names and casing requires exactly one Name fact for every proper noun mention, while the only available encoding buries "NBA" inside an opaque fused kind symbol — so either the Name atom is dropped or a dangling, unrelatable nba symbol is emitted

a bare time NP carrying a restrictive "when"-relative ("Thursday night when X won") — the Time rules attach terms to an event, and nothing states where the time terms go when the modified time NP belongs to a clause that has no licensed encoding
notes: Every emitted atom is true of the sentence and well-typed; the whole of the reviewer's complaint is content the instruction set cannot express (the propositional anaphor and the alias), which the calibration line puts on the gap side. The (Weekday thursday) + bare day-part night composition and the Theme on the unchanged won object are per spec.
